text.tspan: - chunked, compressed, format for N-dimensional data
- fully open and community-led format, with implementations in multiple programming languages.
- partial & lazy reading, including on remote data stores (e.g., S3)
- good disk space / speed, tunable via compression settings
OME-Zarr is rapidly replacing (OME-)TIFF and other proprietary formats across spatial biology tools.

tspan.tspan: A reliable Zarr/OME-Zarr implementation for R to:
- Unlock this data type for existing R packages
- Improve interoperability between R and other
- Serve as the foundation for more specialized
- Full reading & writing support for Zarr v2 & v3 +
implemented on a case by case basis by user
